comments.author: v.zoologov
comments.text:
REVIEW PASSED (security core, BOB-052 .1-.4) — read-only review.

VERDICT: OK. All 6 checklist items hold; security core is sound and well-tested.

🔴 Owner-only decision: maybe_decide() guards 'if not is_owner: return False'; in HandleMessage._maybe_permission it is only reached when interlocutor.kind is OWNER. A non-owner «да»/'/allow'/'/authorize' routes to maybe_request, where the judge classifies it as non-privileged → False (normal chat). No path lets a non-owner approve themselves or anyone. Covered: test_us6_non_owner_da_approves_nobody / _allow_command_approves_nobody.

🔴 Per-request elevation only: on GRANT/AUTHORIZE the executor hands the fulfiller ONLY the stored request.request_text; PrivilegedRequestFulfiller holds no durable state and 'del requester_id' — elevation is one-shot, cannot carry to the requester's other/next messages. Durable access happens ONLY via explicit AUTHORIZE → Authorizer.authorize (allowlist). Covered: test_us6_per_request_elevation_does_not_carry_to_the_next_message, US-5.

🔴 No disclosure without approve / safe default: pending discloses nothing before an owner approve; PermissionExecutor.execute wraps _execute in try/except → logs+drops (safe default = REFUSE, no GUPPI notice, no raise). On AUTHORIZE the durable grant runs FIRST — if it fails the whole thing refuses (nothing fulfilled). Judge failures are swallowed by _SafeDefaultPrivilegeJudge → needs_permission=False (falls through to normal reply). State set to APPROVED before execution; a swallowed exec failure leaves it APPROVED (not PENDING) so it is never re-disclosed. Covered: test_us6_{fulfiller,authorize,channel}_failure_*, _pending_request_discloses_nothing_before_an_approve, _ambiguous_owner_reply_never_accidentally_approves.

BOB-051 intact: judge prompt explicitly treats shared memory/general knowledge as public → non-privileged; gates only tool/internal/owner_data. Authorized members (owner OR allowlisted=Trust.TRUSTED) early-return from maybe_request (US-4 never-enters). Scope = PRIVILEGE_KINDS {tool,internal,owner_data}; triggers only for non-authorized (GUEST) members.

Migration: CREATE TABLE/INDEX IF NOT EXISTS (idempotent, additive); all SQL parameterised (the lone f-string is _COLUMNS, a fixed literal — correctly noqa'd). DDD/Clean respected (domain I/O-free; app owns WHEN/HOW via injected ports; infra adapters in app.py). No regressions.

Minor (non-blocking): in maybe_request the judge is guarded but store.save/notify_owner/tell_requester are not wrapped — an infra failure there propagates out of handle(). It never DISCLOSES (the disclosure/execution path is fully guarded), so the security invariant holds; consider wrapping for turn-robustness parity with the executor.

comments.text:
REVIEW: BOB-011 Phase-1 hybrid memory batch (features/BOB-011) — PASSED.

Scope reviewed: domain/ports.py (Embedder/Reranker), infrastructure/llm/{ollama_embedder,ollama_reranker,embedder_factory,reranker_factory}, infrastructure/persistence/{vector_store,hybrid_recall,sqlite_repo,schema.sql}, application/capabilities/search_memory, app.py wiring, config loader + example, scripts/setup-ollama.sh. 718 tests pass, 98 percent total cov (100 percent on every new memory module), ruff + mypy --strict clean, beadloom lint --strict clean (0 violations), beadloom diff vs main shows no graph-structure change.

CORRECTNESS — PASS.
- RRF fusion (_fuse_rrf, hybrid_recall.py) sums 1/(k0+rank) per list, dedups by content, ties break on insertion order — deterministic and sane. Vector and FTS hits both carry a content key so the dedup key aligns across halves; an item found in both lists accumulates a higher fused score (the point of RRF). k0=60 is the Cormack default.
- Reranker is strictly ADDITIVE: HybridMemoryRecall._rerank returns the pool unchanged when no reranker is wired or the pool is empty; the reranker owns its own graceful fallback (OllamaReranker.rerank returns input candidates unchanged on any failure). MemoryRecall contract is never changed — recall(query, k) still returns Sequence[Recalled].
- search_memory delegates to the injected MemoryRecall (hybrid), clamps a model-supplied k into [1,50] (rejects bool/zero/negative/huge), renders content-only results.
- Backfill is idempotent (LEFT JOIN on memory_vec WHERE v.src_id IS NULL; _has_vector guard on on-write), batched (64); on-write embeds via cursor.lastrowid in save_episode/save_fact.

PRIVACY (KEY) — PASS.
- Embedder and reranker POST only to {base_url}/... where base_url is config-sourced (default local Ollama localhost:11434). No hardcoded external/cloud host anywhere; no OpenAI/Anthropic/cloud SDK in the memory path. Vectors stored in the local SQLite. No path sends fact/episode text off-box.
- No memory content logged: the three logger.warning calls (hybrid_recall, vector_store, ollama_reranker) emit generic strings only. No secrets logged. Minor note below on one diagnostic string.

GRACEFUL DEGRADATION (KEY) — PASS.
- build_application starts with Ollama down: _build_embedder / _build_reranker catch (KeyError, ValueError) and return None; building the embedder never touches the network (only embed()/rerank() do). E2E test proves the app still STARTS when the embedder cannot be built.
- Runtime Ollama-down: HybridMemoryRecall._semantic_candidates catches any embedder exception, logs, returns [] -> pure FTS5. MemoryVectorStore._safe_embed and embed_row are best-effort -> save/boot never crash on embed failure. backfill is a no-op without an embedder. E2E test covers runtime-down -> keyword fallback. Reranker unavailable -> hybrid order unchanged.

ARCHITECTURE (DDD) — PASS.
- Embedder/Reranker ports in domain (Protocol, runtime_checkable); Ollama adapters + vector_store + hybrid_recall in infrastructure; search_memory in application; composition only in app.py. HybridMemoryRecall is a drop-in MemoryRecall. All new modules carry beadloom:domain=bob. Layering holds, no new cycle, mypy/ruff clean.

INSTALLER — PASS.
- scripts/setup-ollama.sh is standalone (downloads the official ollama-darwin.tgz tarball, NO brew install ollama -> does not pull/upgrade python@3.14 and break uv/venv — the documented incident). Idempotent (guards on command -v ollama / existing binary / PATH grep / server-up check). PATH + extraction logic sound (tarball extracted to OLLAMA_DIR, persisted to .zprofile, added to current session). Reviewed as a sanity-check, not executed.

NO REGRESSIONS — PASS.
- 718/718 pass including reactive-chat, proactivity, authz/routing suites. app.py change is additive wiring (embedder into repo, hybrid recall replacing keyword recall behind the same port, search_memory added to the registry). HandleMessage signature unchanged in spirit (recall is still a MemoryRecall).

MINOR (author discretion, non-blocking):
- ollama_reranker.py:203 — _parse_score raises ValueError with f'reranker reply has no numeric score: {reply!r}'. The model REPLY (not memory content) is interned into the message; it is caught and logged via exc_info in rerank(). Low-risk, but if a future model echoes the candidate text into its reply, that text could reach logs at WARNING. Consider logging the score-parse failure without the raw reply, or truncating it.

DOC FRESHNESS NOTE (not a finding against this bead): beadloom sync-check reports architecture.md stale for the new modules. That is exactly the next bead bob-6vo.9 (tech-writer) which this review blocks — out of scope here, flagged for that bead.

Verdict: OK. No Critical, no Major, no Minor blocking. One nitpick (reranker diagnostic string).

comments.author: v.zoologov
comments.text:
REVIEW PASSED (read-only) — BOB-010 Phase 1 drive-engine. Verdict OK. 596 tests pass, 98% cov, ruff + mypy --strict clean, beadloom lint --strict clean (0 violations), doctor clean apart from one expected doc-sync-stale warn that is bob-uns.7 tech-writer scope, not a code defect.

== DIMENSIONS ==

[PASS] Correctness of the human model. urge.py is a pure weighted sum over named drives (mood/longing/salience/circadian/energy), each term in [0,1], normalised by total weight -> monotone non-decreasing in every drive; _longing_drive saturates (1 - exp(-t/tau)) so a day of silence is felt without runaway; circadian is a per-local-hour baseline (night floor, morning + evening peaks, midday dip). Firing is genuinely stochastic, NOT a schedule: decision.py maps urge -> p via a monotone logistic, then draws once from an injected seeded RNG (rng.random() less-than p). Governance (governance.py) is a pure veto layer only: muted, quiet-hours hard floor on LOCAL time (wrap-around window handled), anti-spam per-window ceiling, min-gap, owner-cooldown. allows() returns 'not any(vetoes)' — ceilings, never a driver. Matches 'human, not cron'.

[PASS] Cheap guarantee. engine.tick() runs the pure decision first (_should_speak: store load + window count + urge + seeded draw) — ZERO LLM. Only a genuine fire pays for the Tier-0 gate; only a non-SKIP gate pays for compose. _parse_gate defaults to skip on anything but a 'SAY:' line. Default is silent.

[PASS] Determinism. Time + randomness fully injected: Clock.now() everywhere; the only random. in src is the injected seeded random.Random and a SystemRandom used solely to PICK a fallback seed (not the draw). No datetime.now()/utcnow() in proactivity src except the documented _SystemClock fallback in proactivity_sources.py, which app.py injects over. Reproducible under a fixed seed (e2e pins it).

[PASS] Architecture (DDD) + per-persona. domain/proactivity is pure (no I/O, no clock, frozen slots dataclasses); engine in application depends only on ports/protocols; composition is only in app.py. All state keyed by persona_id (store + engine + RecordOwnerActivity) so replicas are isolated. ProactiveTick is registered on the heartbeat cadence wrapped in _TICK_RETRY_POLICY (resilient). RecordOwnerActivity folds owner messages in best-effort (handle_message swallows + logs). All modules carry beadloom:domain=bob; lint --strict green.

[PASS] No regressions / no anti-human patterns. Reactive chat + authz/routing intact (owner_activity is an optional seam, unwired = prior behaviour; multibot /quiet,/wake fall through to a silent drop without a store). Gate + compose prompts lean on Higher Mind (mood tone, reflect salience) with no canned templates and no forced positivity.

== FINDING ==

[MINOR] Timed mute never auto-expires (known gap, non-blocking). guppi.py _quiet() on '/quiet 2h' both sets proactivity_enabled=False AND writes mute_until = now + 2h. But mute_until has NO consumer: engine.py:168 derives 'muted=not state.proactivity_enabled' and never reads store.get_mute_until(). So '/quiet 2h' behaves identically to a bare '/quiet' — permanent until '/wake'; the 2h auto-unmute never happens. The expiry check is MISSING from application/proactivity/engine.py:160-169 (_should_speak), which would need to read get_mute_until and treat 'now greater-or-equal expiry' as un-muted (ideally also clearing it). get_mute_until() exists (proactivity_store.py:101) and is round-trip tested, but nothing calls it in src (grep: zero consumers). Severity MINOR: functional gap, not a safety/correctness defect — the owner can always '/wake', the ceiling errs SAFE (stays quieter, never spams), and the persistence/command surface is already built so the consumer is a small follow-up. Recommend a follow-up bead (consume get_mute_until in _should_speak + a test asserting auto-unmute after expiry); does not block this merge.

Note: doctor's 'Sync stale: architecture.md vs record_owner_activity.py' is expected and is bob-uns.7 (tech-writer) scope, not a code issue.

Scope reviewed: commit e998ff0 on features/BOB-007, src/bob/infrastructure/telegram/gateway.py (drafts-first streaming for all chats + edit/plain fallback), plus its tests and the architecture doc. Read-only review.

== Correctness — PASS ==
- Native rich drafts are tried FIRST for every chat incl. topics: _stream_reply_drafts_first calls _try_rich_draft (send_rich_message_draft) pinned to reply_thread_id, unthrottled (no _await_throttle on the primary path). Verified by test_topic_streams_via_native_rich_drafts_not_edits (no edits, no sleeps, thread-pinned).
- Fallback triggers cleanly on TelegramBadRequest: confirmed via the aiogram hierarchy — TelegramBadRequest is an AiogramError and is NOT a TelegramRetryAfter, so it is caught by the (AiogramError, ValueError) clause (after RetryAfter backoff), returning False -> _stream_reply_live_edit(seed=accumulated). The TEXTDRAFT_PEER_INVALID case is covered by test_topic_draft_rejected_falls_back_to_throttled_edit_streaming.
- Reply NEVER lost across draft -> edit -> plain: _finish_live_edit commits rich final; on rich failure it edits the placeholder; if that edit also fails it _send_plain. Directly proven by test_topic_draft_and_edit_both_fail_degrades_to_plain_send (drafts_rejected + edit_fails + rich_final_fails -> plain send still lands in-thread). No token loss on fallback: the rejected token text is already in accumulated/seed and the same tokens iterator is drained by the edit path.
- RichBlockThinking/rich content delivered via the draft path: test_topic_draft_stream_includes_thinking_block asserts the thinking text in the committed rich final.

== No regressions — PASS ==
- Hybrid reply-tiering (BOB-006): reply_tier_selector.py / llm_router.py are NOT in the diff — untouched.
- Authz/routing (BOB-003/005): _passes_gate / _handle_owner_command / intake unchanged in the diff.
- Flood-control throttle on the edit fallback: _await_throttle still gates _edit and the rich final on the fallback path (last_edit_at), so the fallback cannot flood. test asserts clock.slept is non-empty on fallback and empty on the primary path.
- The only non-gateway production change is none; test_handle_message.py change is a test-only adaptation to the rich draft/commit channel (no logic change).

== Architecture (DDD) — PASS ==
- Streaming stays in infrastructure/telegram behind the BotLike seam; beadloom lint --strict: 0 violations. mypy --strict and ruff clean (src + tests). 530 tests pass.
- Doc freshness: docs/architecture.md prose already describes the drafts-first model + fallback (lines ~191-201, 296-323) accurately — verified by grep, not just sync-check [ok]. (Final polish is BEAD-03/tech-writer.)

== Resource/robustness — PASS ==
- No unbounded retry loops: the only while-True loops are RetryAfter backoffs that return on success or on a non-RetryAfter error. Draft failure caught narrowly via (AiogramError, ValueError) — no bare except. No secrets logged (chat_id / exception text only).

== Minor (author discretion, non-blocking) ==
1. gateway.py:662 stream_reply_rich is now production-dead — only stream_reply is wired into handle_message/multibot. It is still tested and harmless, but consider removing it (and the _draft_unsupported_chats memo it is the sole reader of) in a cleanup, or document why the seam method is retained.
2. gateway.py:436/692 the primary _stream_reply_drafts_first path does NOT consult _draft_unsupported_chats, so a peer that previously rejected drafts re-attempts one failing send_rich_message_draft every turn before falling back. Reply always lands (not a correctness issue) — a small optimization would memoize the rejection into the drafts-first path.
3. gateway.py:500 pending_tokens = self._batch_tokens if seed else 0 is immediately overwritten by the if seed: ... pending_tokens = 0 block below — the conditional initializer is dead; can be simplified to pending_tokens = 0.

All review dimensions PASS. Reply-never-lost and tiering/authz no-regression specifically verified. 0 critical, 0 major, 3 minor.

comments.author: v.zoologov
comments.text:
REVIEW PASSED (verdict: OK). BOB-003 two-bot gateway + topic-scope. Branch features/BOB-003 @ 276a15e. 466 tests pass, ruff clean, mypy --strict clean, beadloom lint --strict 0 violations, doctor OK.

=== CORRECTNESS: PASS ===
- Multi-bot polling: one MultiBotGateway polls every registration via _poll_bot; offsets tracked per identity; isolation verified (test_one_bot_poll_failure_does_not_kill_the_other) — typed except (OSError/RuntimeError/TimeoutError), logs identity.value only.
- Cross-bot dedup: keyed (chat_id, message_id) at multibot.py:245-249, processed once independent of delivering bot. Verified test_cross_bot_dedup_processes_once + test_distinct_messages_both_processed (no legit message dropped — unique per-message key).
- Bob topic-scope: BotScope.matches requires chat_id AND message_thread_id == topic_id (multibot.py:92-94). In-topic handled; General/other topic/foreign chat dropped (tests cover general/other-topic/foreign).
- Thread-reply: inner Bob TelegramGateway built with reply_thread_id=scope.topic_id; every send pins message_thread_id (gateway.py diff). Verified test_bob_reply_streamer_sets_thread_id.
- GUPPI reject path: route() returns False after _guppi_reject BEFORE the Bob intake call (multibot.py:260-264 vs 267) — Bob pipeline structurally unreachable on the reject path, not merely test-asserted. Verified test_unauthorized_in_bob_topic_triggers_guppi_reject (received==[], bob.sends==[]).
- Owner commands: GuppiHandler.handle_general_command gates on chat_id==general AND is_owner (guppi.py:92). Verified owner-grant, status, non-owner-ignored.

=== ARCHITECTURE (DDD): PASS ===
- Telegram stays in infrastructure behind ReplyStreamer/EventBus seam; Bob path publishes MessageReceived onto the bus (no direct coupling). lint --strict 0 violations (layering holds).
- BotRegistry is a clean seam: adding a bot == one register() call (forward-compatible for replicas). Composition only in app.py (_build_multibot). multibot.py + guppi.py both carry # beadloom:domain=bob (module coverage clean).

=== SECURITY (KEY): PASS ===
- No double-processing / no message loss: dedup key is unique per Telegram message; the gate is applied deterministically on first delivery, so suppressing the cross-bot duplicate cannot let an unauthorized message slip through the second bot, and cannot drop a distinct legit message. No auth bypass via the second bot.
- Authz no-bypass: the inner Bob TelegramGateway is constructed WITHOUT an authorizer (multibot.py:156-165), so the router's route() is the SINGLE gate for the Bob path — _inner[BOB].intake is only reached after _is_authorized passes (multibot.py:260-267). The BOB-002 single-gate property is preserved in the multi-bot router (no double-gate, no ungated path). Stranger DM / foreign chat stay silent (test_stranger_dm_is_silent — no reject, no reveal). Owner commands owner-only.
- Tokens: both bot tokens env-only (BOB_TELEGRAM__TOKEN / GUPPI_TELEGRAM__TOKEN explicit mapping in loader); never inlined (example yaml documents env, no value); never logged (poll-failure log emits identity.value + exc, not the token). _build_real_bot raises KeyError naming the identity, not the token.

=== STANDARDS: PASS ===
- Clock injection (SystemClock in app; _zero_clock for inner gateways). Parameterized SQL untouched (persistence unchanged). No print, no bare except (only typed excepts). No datetime.now() without Clock. No mutable defaults. Only # type: ignore additions are [attr-defined,no-any-return] at the untyped-aiogram boundary in _AiogramBotAdapter — justified, consistent with the existing adapter pattern.

=== MINOR (author discretion, non-blocking) ===
- Minor (multibot.py:168) _seen_messages is an unbounded set growing for process lifetime (mirrors BOB-002 _seen_update_ids). Practical impact low (offset advancement stops Telegram redelivering old updates), but a long-lived process accumulates keys. Consider a bounded LRU/deque eviction in a follow-up. Pre-existing pattern, not introduced anew.
- Nitpick (multibot.py:213) poll-failure exc is logged verbatim; an aiogram network exception could in theory embed a token-bearing URL. Very low probability; consider scrubbing if ever observed.

=== DOC NOTE (for tech-writer bead bob-6ub.7, NOT a review blocker) ===
beadloom sync-check reports bob/architecture.md stale vs multibot.py / guppi.py / gateway.py / loader.py / app.py (symbols/hash changed). This is the expected pre-tech-writer state; bob-6ub.7 (blocked by this review) must refresh architecture.md to reflect BotRegistry / MultiBotGateway / GuppiHandler / two-bot config before the Gate. Flagging so it is not missed.

All review dimensions PASS. Verdict OK.

1) CORRECTNESS = PASS.
- aiogram migration preserves behavior: dedup via _seen_update_ids + offset advance (max(offset, update_id+1)) identical to BOB-001; draft streaming batches by batch_tokens, throttles via injected clock/sleep, backs off on TelegramRetryAfter (gateway.py:332-377).

RichBlockThinking rendered as leading collapsible block when thinking present (rich.py:102-113). Empty reply with no thinking sends nothing.
- retry.py: is_transient classifies aiohttp ClientConnectionError (covers ServerDisconnectedError) + TimeoutError + 5xx as transient; everything else permanent and re-raised at once; CancelledError re-raised; bounded by max_attempts with exponential backoff (retry.py:50-111). Provider uses aiohttp so the classification matches the real client.
- Tick isolation: periodic() re-raises CancelledError, logs+continues on Exception, wraps tick in retry_with_backoff when a RetryPolicy is given (heartbeat.py:76-101). One bad tick cannot kill the loop or its siblings.
- Tool-loop TERMINATES: bounded by _DEFAULT_MAX_TURNS=6, returns final text when no tool_calls, returns '' + warns on cap (tool_loop.py:61-73). Unknown capability fed back as tool error message; any dispatch Exception caught + logged so a tool failure never crashes the turn (tool_loop.py:75-91). Empty-registry path UNCHANGED: HandleMessage engages the loop only when a tool provider is wired AND registry is non-empty, else the plain router path (handle_message.py:191-203).

2) ARCHITECTURE (DDD/Clean) = PASS.
- New ports Capability, ToolCallingProvider, AllowlistStore (+ ToolCall/ToolCallResult value objects) all live in domain/ports.py. Gateway/persistence/llm stay in infrastructure; composition only in app.py.
- Gateway depends on application only via a structural AuthorizerLike Protocol + the MessageReceived event import (infra -> application is allowed); it never imports the concrete Authorizer (gateway.py:131-141).
- beadloom lint --strict = 0 violations; the layering guard test (tests/application/test_layering.py) holds and passed.

3) SECURITY (KEY) = PASS.
- Authz, single enforcement point: the ONLY gate is TelegramGateway.intake/_passes_gate (gateway.py:202-250). Dedup -> gate -> publish; no other path publishes MessageReceived. is_authorized is checked BEFORE owner-command handling, so an unauthorized update can never reach /authorize. Disallowed chat OR unauthorized user -> silently dropped (no MessageReceived, no reply).
- /authorize is owner-only: _handle_owner_command returns False unless is_owner(user_id); a non-owner's /authorize text simply falls through as an ordinary message (per RFC) (gateway.py:252-273).
- Chat-scope binds even the owner: Authorizer.is_authorized rejects any chat outside allowed_chat_ids for everyone (authorizer.py:53-65) -> a leaked token in a foreign chat is dead. Fail-closed defaults: owner_id=0 + empty allowed_chat_ids authorizes nobody.

- Tool-loop abuse: recall_memory is permission='safe', validates that 'query' is a str and raises otherwise (recall_memory.py:69-75). FTS injection sanitization HOLDS: _to_match_query tokenizes to word chars, drops operator punctuation, quotes each term, OR-joins; SQL is fully parameterized (fts_recall.py:59-111). A model-driven query cannot inject FTS operators or SQL.

4) STANDARDS = PASS. Clock/sleep injected throughout (SystemClock, _async_sleep, _monotonic); parameterized SQL only; no print; no bare except (the two broad 'except Exception' in tool_loop/heartbeat are justified with comments, log via logger.exception, and re-raise CancelledError); secrets never logged; mypy --strict + ruff clean.

- Nitpick (pre-existing, NOT a BOB-002 regression): _seen_update_ids grows unbounded over a 24/7 process. Confirmed identical on main (BOB-001). Since the poll offset advances past handled updates, dedup mainly guards in-batch redelivery; a bounded structure (e.g. deque maxlen) would be tidier. Out of scope for this batch.

description: Read-only ревью; находки в комментарии беада. PLAN BEAD-09.

comments.author: v.zoologov
comments.text:
REVIEW (BEAD-09) — BOB-001 P0 slice (7 dev beads + test). Read-only. Verdict: ISSUES (1 Major, 2 Minor). Gates reproduced green locally: 216 pytest pass, ruff clean, mypy --strict clean, beadloom lint --strict 0 violations, sync-check rc0.

DIMENSION VERDICTS
- Correctness: PASS. perceive->decide->act->persist flow correct (handle_message.py). Tier1->Tier0 fallback correct and, crucially, the payload is built ONCE (llm_router.run -> _build_messages) so the redacted Tier-1 payload is exactly what the Tier-0 fallback sends — privacy holds on the fallback path too (explicitly tested: test_fallback_to_tier0_still_redacts_personal_context). Genesis idempotent via on-disk SOUL.md flag (run_genesis.run short-circuits, no LLM/file touch); malformed Tier1 output rejected loudly (GenesisError; 3 hardening tests). Mood/Taste/Negotiation pure + deterministic + bounded; heartbeat ticks (InnerMonologue feeds Mood, MoodDrift homeostasis, Reflect logs episode) correct and error-isolated in periodic().
- Security/Privacy: PASS. Redaction by construction: LLMRouter._build_messages attaches personal_context ONLY when the task's preferred tier is Tier 0 (stays_local); a Tier-1-bound request is never given the raw context. Asserted by unit + e2e privacy tests (recall-secret + phantom-secret never reach Tier 1). Secrets: telegram.token and llm.tier1_api_key come from config/env only (factory._optional_str, app._build_real_bot) — never inlined; no Authorization header when key absent (Tier 0). yaml.safe_load everywhere (loader, run_genesis). All SQL parameterized (?) — sqlite_repo.py is the single SQL home; FTS user text tokenized to OR-of-quoted-terms (fts_recall._to_match_query) — injection/syntax safe. pathlib throughout.
- Standards (CONTEXT.md): PASS. datetime.now() appears ONLY inside SystemClock.now() in app.py; everywhere else the injected Clock is used. No print(), no bare except, no mutable defaults. Domain dataclasses frozen+slots with invariant checks in __post_init__. Type hints on public surfaces.

FINDINGS

Major 1 — Architecture: application layer imports concrete infrastructure types (violates infra->application->domain).
- src/bob/application/usecases/handle_message.py:45 — 'from bob.infrastructure.telegram.events import MessageReceived'
- src/bob/application/usecases/run_genesis.py:44 — 'from bob.infrastructure.persistence.soul_store import JsonValue, SoulStore'
Why: declared layering is infrastructure -> application -> domain; the application must not depend on infrastructure. Both imports are TYPE_CHECKING-only (no runtime cycle, wiring still in app.py), but they are a real layering leak AND directly contradict this layer's own stated invariant — application/__init__.py docstring says it 'never imports bob.infrastructure'. So either the code or the documented invariant is wrong.
Recommendation: move the transport event + persistence contract the use-cases depend on to a layer the application owns. (a) Define MessageReceived (or a MessageReceivedLike Protocol carrying chat_id/text/sender_name) in domain/ports or application; the telegram gateway produces it, the use-case consumes the abstraction. (b) RunGenesis should depend on a SoulStore *port* (Protocol) declared in domain/application, with the concrete Sqlite/file SoulStore bound in app.py; JsonValue likewise belongs with that port, not imported from persistence. Net: zero application->infrastructure imports, restoring the docstring's invariant.

Minor 1 — Architecture/graph: beadloom lint --strict evaluated only 1 rule and the entire src/bob tree is annotated as a single 'beadloom:domain=bob' node, so the graph has no layer sub-model and CANNOT enforce the infra/app/domain boundary (it did not catch Major 1). The hexagon is real in the source but invisible to the tool. Recommendation (for the tech-writer/graph bead BEAD-10): introduce per-layer beadloom nodes (domain / application / infrastructure) + a forbid-import rule application->infrastructure so the boundary is machine-checked, not just convention.

Minor 2 — Typing consistency: src/bob/app.py _PtbBotAdapter.get_updates (l.406) and send_message (l.409) carry '# type: ignore[no-untyped-def]' and omit return annotations, while edit_message_text (l.412) is annotated '-> object'. The ignores at the PTB boundary are justified, but annotate the two return types (-> Sequence[UpdateLike] / -> _MessageLike or object) to drop the no-untyped-def ignores and match the third method.

Nitpick — tests/application/usecases/test_run_genesis_hardening.py imports the private _parse_personality. Acceptable (it tests the validation contract) but a public seam would be cleaner.

RESULT: ISSUES — 0 critical, 1 major, 2 minor. Do NOT merge until Major 1 (application->infrastructure layering leak) is fixed; coordinator to open a fix-bead. Minor 1 fits naturally into the BEAD-10 graph/docs work.

comments.text:
REVIEW — BOB-050 (.1–.4) — ISSUES (1 major). Gate green: ruff clean, mypy --strict clean (400 files), pytest 2771 passed.

The domain/application/infrastructure logic is correct, semantic, bounded, per-person, decorative, and migration-safe (all 6 checklist axes pass at the unit level). But the feature is NOT wired end-to-end, so it does nothing in production.

Major — src/bob/app.py (build_application, ~line 802): PerceiveReaction is NEVER instantiated and BOB_MESSAGE_REACTION is NEVER subscribed. The ONLY bus subscription is `event_bus.subscribe(MESSAGE_RECEIVED, ...)`. The gateway publishes BobMessageReaction (gateway.py / multibot._route_reaction), but AsyncEventBus.publish is a clean no-op when no handler is registered (event_bus.py:44), so every reaction event is silently dropped. Consequences in production:
  - .2 perception (mood lift, BOB-014 warmth nudge, BOB-045 per-person reaction memory, NotableReaction record) never runs.
  - .3 being-received acknowledgment can never fire: handle_message reads KvNotableReactionStore.latest(), but that store is ONLY written by PerceiveReaction._note_being_received — which is never constructed. The store is always empty, so the aloud hint is permanently inert.
  PerceiveReaction's own docstring claims 'it subscribes to the BobMessageReaction event' — false in the wiring.
  Recommendation: in build_application, construct PerceiveReaction (judge=LlmReactionJudge(router=...), lookup=memory_repo.episode_by_bob_message_id seam, resolver=ReactorPerception(authorizer), state=personality_state, relationships, memory=memory_repo, notable=KvNotableReactionStore(memory_repo), clock, disposition) and `event_bus.subscribe(BOB_MESSAGE_REACTION, _as_handler(perceive_reaction.perceive))`.

Minor — tests: no build_application-based test asserts the BOB_MESSAGE_REACTION subscription. test_reaction_perception_acceptance.py constructs PerceiveReaction directly (line 170), so the missing wire slipped past the .4 test wave. Add an integration test that the assembled app subscribes a reaction consumer (and that a published BobMessageReaction reaches PerceiveReaction).

Verified OK (no action): semantic-not-table (sign/magnitude from sentiment words in reaction_judgment.py, never emoji); authz per-person containment bidirectional (handle_message._acknowledgment_for guards note.sender_id != interlocutor.sender_id, anonymous sender_id=None dropped, no owner facts written); decorative/reliability (perceive() try/except, judge raises not defaults, store decode→None, publish no-op, GUPPI gateway gets no filter); bounded effects (caps 0.25 mood / 0.12 warmth, clamps, BOB-030 band); migration idempotent + non-destructive guarded ALTER with post-ALTER index + parameterized SQL; consume-once clear (roll-before-clear); injected judge/store/rng/clock.

No false positives / no mangling — CONFIRMED. recurring_closer returns the final notable phrase ONLY when it recurs >= min_occurrences in the wide window (one-off ending -> None; below tic_min_words -> None). strip_recurring_closer is a lossless _split_sentences round-trip: drops only the LAST sentence whose normalised content == closer (+trailing short tail), rstrip tidies; distinct/blank closer -> no-op; earlier legitimate reuse of the phrase is preserved (removes only the final occurrence). Multi-sentence body survives. Well covered.
3. Bounded / no loop — YES. for _ in range(_MAX_REGENERATIONS); after the bound a single deterministic strip, no loop. test_persistent_(scattered_)tic_is_stripped_after_the_bound assert exactly 3 generations then strip.
4. Not a scripted directive — YES. Pure/deterministic domain helpers (recurring_closer/strip_recurring_closer/_split_sentences/_final_notable_phrase, no I/O); structural detect + regenerate + strip. No 'do not say X' prompt.
5. No regressions / DDD — CLEAN. _notable_phrases refactor to _split_sentences is behaviour-preserving (same boundary split). BOB-026/032/036 paths intact; recall-grounding untouched; only new I/O is the one recent_episodes wide fetch (guest-skipped, mirrors guard). New helpers are pure domain; config wired in app.py with __post_init__ validation (tic_lookback>=1). DDD layering respected.

Minor (author's discretion, non-blocking): when the WHOLE final draft is the recurring tic (single notable sentence == closer), strip_recurring_closer returns '' — handle_message._recompose would then 'return ''' (empty reply). Reachability is low (requires every draft across the bound to be tic-only), but an empty outbound message could fail downstream. Gate (.venv, read-only): ruff clean · mypy --strict clean (357 files) · pytest 2462 passed.

1. PR_OPEN terminal — SAFE. is_terminal(PR_OPEN)=True only adds PR_OPEN to _TERMINAL. can_approve_plan(PR_OPEN)=can_transition(PR_OPEN,EXECUTING) → is_terminal(frm) short-circuits to False, so NO new path to EXECUTING. EXECUTING remains in exactly one target set (PLAN_READY). _PROGRESS dropped PR_OPEN→DONE; PR_OPEN has no outgoing transitions. A PR_OPEN session is now non-blocking: _active_session() filters terminal → active_state()=None → a fresh dev-task PLANS from scratch. DONE kept as legacy terminal (unreachable). No leak.

2. Broadened approve/stop — SAFE. is_approval fires ONLY when: not is_stop (stop-first), no standalone negation (не/нет veto), reply ≤6 words, and an affirmative token present — all word-boundary matched via padded ' token ' (so 'да' inside 'создай'/'сдавай' does NOT bite). A new/long off-topic message or a deferral ('а давай попозже…') won't auto-approve. _route_active drives approve_plan ONLY when state is PLAN_READY; approve_plan re-checks can_approve_plan + owner. Worst case (false-approve) executes the already-shown plan in isolation (worktree/branch/PR, never main, human merges) — acceptable per canon. NL still cannot reach EXECUTING except explicit approve of a waiting plan.

3. Narrate suppression — CORRECT. Per-tool is_error → None; top-level 'error' stream event has no handler → noise (None). SUCCESS lines ('тесты прошли') still narrated; final 'result' event still surfaces 'готово'/'ошибка:…'. The use-case error path is UNCHANGED: a genuine runner/PR fault raises → CodingAssistant._fail → FAILED, Bob-voiced session_voice.failed() to owner. A genuinely failed run still tells the owner.

4. Bob-topic notifier — CORRECT. _GuppiOwnerNotifier wires topic_id=telegram.bob.topic_id; send() uses message_thread_id==topic_id (rich markdown path), plain fallback keeps the same topic; unset→0/None falls back to General gracefully. Tests pin topic threading + plain fallback + General-fallback branch.

5. BOB-039/040/041 invariants intact: plan-gate непробиваем, owner-only on every mutator, never-merge/never-main (commit_and_push of bob/<slug> branch, gh pr create only), worktree isolation+finally cleanup, kill-switch (stop-first → CANCELLED), NL-can't-bypass-gate. comments.author: v.zoologov
comments.text:
REVIEW PASSED (SECURITY GATE) — BOB-039 bob-3ro.5. Read-only, adversarial. Gate: ruff clean, mypy --strict clean (344 files), pytest 2335 passed.

HARD INVARIANTS 1-7 — ALL HOLD:

1. Plan gate unbypassable — CONFIRMED. `EXECUTING` is set in exactly ONE place (coding_assistant.approve_plan, line 212), reachable only after owner check + can_approve_plan(PLAN_READY). The domain table (state.py _PROGRESS) lists EXECUTING as a target of PLAN_READY only; terminal states have no outgoing. The only execute-mode runner.run is _narrate_run ← _execute_and_open_pr ← approve_plan. start() uses _PLAN_MODE exclusively. No stray transition, no re-entrant bypass.

2. Never merge / never main — CONFIRMED. PullRequestOpener port has only `open` (no merge). GhPullRequestOpener builds ONLY `gh pr create --base main --head <branch>`. `main` appears solely as PR --base. grep across all infra+usecase finds no `gh pr merge`, no `git push`, no auto-merge. The execute prompt explicitly forbids main/merge/push-to-main.

3. Isolation/privacy — CONFIRMED. GitWorktree runs `git worktree add` (tracked files only → gitignored data/soul, bob.db*, .env*, config/* are ABSENT). Claude runner cwd = worktree path (never repo root). The .4 isolation test uses REAL git on a throwaway temp repo with gitignored secret files mirroring the live repo and asserts every secret is absent from the checkout — a genuine proof of exclusion, not a mock.

4. Owner-only — CONFIRMED. Every use-case method (start/approve_plan/stop/status) calls owner.is_owner(sender) first (silent refusal). GUPPI handle_general_command gates on is_owner before dispatch (defense-in-depth); _run_code forwards the verified owner id. A guest cannot start/approve/execute.

5. Shell-free / no injection — CONFIRMED. All subprocess via create_subprocess_exec (ExecRunner, _ExecStreamRunner) — no shell. claude --permission-mode validated against fixed allowlist {plan, acceptEdits}; a misconfigured permission_mode (e.g. bypassPermissions) is REFUSED before launch. Branch validated by is_safe_branch (^bob/<slug>$ regex closes ../slash/space/flag injection); worktree remove path is symlink-resolved containment-checked. title/body/prompt/task are discrete argv items, never interpolated.

6. Kill-switch + no leak — CONFIRMED. stop sets per-session cancel flag (narrate loop breaks → runner aclose kills+reaps process), → CANCELLED, cleanup. approve_plan removes worktree in finally on EVERY exit (PR_OPEN/FAILED/mid-run stop); start's plan-fail path cleans up (cleanup=True). Cleanup is idempotent best-effort, never masks outcome. No worktree leak on any terminal outcome.

7. Off-by-default & not autonomous — CONFIRMED. coder.enabled=False default; assistant built only when on. Not on goals.safe_capabilities (empty default; test proves enabling coder never injects a capability). It is a use-case, not a registered Capability — cannot ride the self-directed goal tick.

8. RACE (.4-flagged, ~line 274) — SAFETY-NEUTRAL / COSMETIC. A `stop` during PLANNING is clobbered back to PLAN_READY because start() advances its LOCAL session var after _run_plan without re-reading the store. Adversarial trace: (a) to actually EXECUTE, the owner must still issue a FRESH explicit /code approve — there is NO auto-execution; (b) the session id remains in self._cancelled (stop never clears it), so a subsequent approve_plan breaks the narrate loop on the first event and opens NO PR — the stale flag makes the clobbered session even safer; (c) stop already removed the worktree and start does not recreate it → no worktree leak. Net effect is purely UX: a stopped plan still shows PLAN_READY and the plan message is sent post-stop. No path to unapproved execution, owner-bypass, or leak. Recommend a documented follow-up (re-check cancel flag after _run_plan), NON-blocking.

9. DDD/Clean/determinism — CLEAN. domain/coding is pure (frozen+slots entity, injected clock `at`, no I/O); ports define the seams; infra realizes; app wires. All modules carry `# beadloom:domain=bob`. mypy --strict clean, ruff clean, 2335 tests pass. No regressions to T3.A/dialogue/authz/goals.

MINOR (non-blocking): self._cancelled set grows unbounded over process lifetime (one uuid per stop) — negligible. Follow-up for the .4 race re-check noted above.

VERDICT: OK — all hard invariants hold; race is safety-neutral.

Order of enforcement in read_file: (a) pure name-based guard.allows_path BEFORE any disk touch; (b) realpath-containment re-check that resolves symlinks and re-asserts the REAL path stays under an allowed root BEFORE open. Containment is computed on realpaths for BOTH target and roots (os.path.realpath), so a symlinked repo root (macOS /var→/private/var) is not a false denial, while a link escaping into a denied tree is refused with no read.

comments.text:
REVIEW PASSED (OK, 1 minor) — reviewer verdict for BOB-061 anti-tic double-fix on features/BOB-061.

GATES (read-only): pytest 3267 passed; ruff clean; mypy clean (454 files); beadloom lint --strict 0 violations; beadloom diff --since main = no graph boundary changes (new SqliteCloserLog carries beadloom:domain=bob, no new node/edge, no cycle).

1) US-4 LIVENESS (highest) — PASS. The nudge is a genuine SOFT variety steer (_CLOSER_TIC_NUDGE: «заверши ПО-ДРУГОМУ, своими словами, не меняя смысла») — not a ban / forbidden-phrase list / topic restriction; test_soft_nudge_wording_steers_variety_without_banning_meaning locks it. No-tic → nudge='' AND recalled unchanged → context byte-for-byte identical to the pre-BOB-061 (unwired) turn: test_no_tic_reply_context_is_byte_identical_to_the_unwired_turn proves zero reply change even though the ring is now always-wired. False-positive risk contained: clustering is LEXICAL near-verbatim (SequenceMatcher), so meaning-level repetition in DIFFERENT words scores low and does NOT cluster; 0.82 is conservative (variants ~0.88-0.94 cluster, distinct ~0.2-0.25 do not; distinct-below-threshold → no nudge tested). Detector fires only on a genuinely-recurring ending.

2) CROSS-SESSION CATCH (the real bug) — PASS. persist∪window is load-bearing: test_cross_session_union_of_persist_and_window_catches_the_tic (2 persisted prior-session closers + 1 live-window occurrence → fires) vs test_persist_alone_below_threshold_does_not_nudge (same 2 persisted, no window → stays one below → no fire). is_recurring_closer_tic counts near-verbatim occurrences correctly (current excluded from its own count; min_occurrences boundary inclusive, tested); one-off closer never fires. Ring cap 30, append-after-reply, DELETE-keep-newest prune — sound; markers (silent/react/outage) never logged.

3) ROOT FIX (.7) — PASS. Meme signature («пусть остаётся как есть»/«мне так спокойнее»/«оставить как есть») removed from _ANTI_BAIT + _VARIABLE_FORM (parametrized test_no_injected_voice_directive_seeds_the_meme_closer + no-pairs guard). Replacements still teach the point (test_anti_bait_still_teaches_its_point / test_variable_form_still_teaches_variety): _VARIABLE_FORM models genuine terse↔expansive variety AND adds an explicit «заканчивай по-разному» directive against a fixed closer — does NOT install a new fixed signature. _GUPPI_CANON «спокойнее»→«рад» preserves meaning ('quietly glad') while removing the priming token.

4) PRIVACY/LOCALITY — PASS. closer_log is Bob's own normalised closer phrases (never full replies), local SQLite (his memory DB), bounded ring cap 30, no leak; migration idempotent (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS in schema.sql + ensure_schema).

5) DECORATIVE/DDD — PASS. append/recent/detect wrapped → normal reply on failure (never breaks the turn), tested decorative on both read + append failure. Domain pure (closer_text/is_same_closer_motif/is_recurring_closer_tic — no I/O, thresholds injected); infra behind CloserLog port; app wires SqliteCloserLog + reads repeat.motif_similarity_threshold. All SQL parameterised. No new runtime dep. disposition.py/BOB-033 optimism invariants untouched — .3 empirically confirmed non-driver with 2 characterization tests pinning no comfort-closer across the optimism range.

6) TESTS lock the invariants; coverage real (24 domain + store, 30+ handle_message incl liveness/union/decorative, 5 voice seed-removed + pedagogy-preserved, 2 disposition). No-hardcode generality proven via property tests (test_motif_clustering_is_general_for_an_arbitrary_motif / test_arbitrary_motif_recurring_once_per_session_is_a_tic).

MINOR (author's discretion, non-blocking): _detect_closer_tic builds closers = (*persisted, *window_closers) — a multiset CONCATENATION, not the set-UNION the CONTEXT/comments describe. Across a MULTI-TURN session the current session's closers sit in BOTH the persist ring (appended after each reply) and the live window, so they are double-weighted, lowering the effective occurrence bar for within-session repeats. Harmless in practice — it can only fire on GENUINE repetition (never on non-repeated/varied endings), the effect is a soft nudge (not a ban), and it aligns with BOB-043's within-session anti-tic intent; the target cross-session scenario is unaffected (the in-progress closer is not yet appended at detect time). Consider de-duping the two sources if strict union semantics are desired.

EMPIRICAL FINDING (BOB-061 .3) — disposition is NOT a driver of the recurring closer.

Investigation:
- Disposition (domain/personality/disposition.py) is a two-trait affective vector
  (optimism, resilience). Its derivations feed ONLY: reappraisal_probability (gate for
  reframing a dark thought → constructive), social-contagion magnitudes (mood lift/dip),
  and social_lift_rate (mood recovery). No status-quo/comfort/"leave-as-is" trait or
  derivation exists.
- Its ONLY textual surface into any prompt is _valence_lean_line in build_reflection_prompt
  (reflection.py): leans toward OPTIMISM in proportion to the trait and explicitly permits
  a genuine low. It is NOT a status-quo/comfort stance, and it rotates with REFLECTION_ANGLES
  per tick.
- handle_message.py (the REPLY path) references disposition/reappraisal NOWHERE — the reply
  prompt is built from mood/stance/taste/relationship only. Disposition shapes just the
  inner monologue + mood; it reaches a reply solely via the optional leak_inner_life flavour
  path, already covered by .1/.2 text-level strip.
- Reappraisal MOVES a dark thought to a constructive one (probabilistic, negative-only) —
  the OPPOSITE of a sticky comfort rut; it cannot regenerate a fixed «оставить как есть» motif.

Where the literal motif actually comes from (text-level, confirms .1/.2 scope): the exact
tic phrases «пусть остаётся как есть. Мне так спокойнее» / «лучше оставить как есть» live in
domain/personality/voice.py as few-shot VOICE exemplars (_ANTI_BAIT L55, _VARIABLE_FORM L86),
injected into the reply prompt as "substance-ending" closers. That is a prompt/recall text
seed — exactly the phenomenon .1 (cross-session persist) + .2 (near-verbatim detect + strip +
soft nudge) address. NOTE for test/review wave: the voice.py exemplar itself is a candidate
seed of the motif; out of scope for THIS (disposition) bead and NOT changed (editing persona
voice risks flattening Bob) — flagging for consideration.

REVIEW PASSED (OK) — BOB-059 .3 review of resolve_bot_identities.

Verified against all 6 dimensions:

1. Core fix CORRECT. `from aiogram.exceptions import TelegramNetworkError` added; the except tuple now includes it (OSError, RuntimeError, TimeoutError, TelegramNetworkError). get_me is wrapped in call_with_retry, which re-invokes it up to `attempts` times and re-raises the LAST exception on exhaustion → caught → warn+return → startup continues. The persistent-flap crash is genuinely fixed. Test `test_persistent_network_error_does_not_crash_startup` + parametrized `test_each_network_degradation_class_warns_and_returns` lock it (get_me_calls==3, no raise, bob_user_id() None).

2. No over-catch CONFIRMED. except lists SPECIFIC network types, NOT bare Exception. call_with_retry itself catches `except Exception` (generic-by-design, documented in reliability.py) so it retries ALL exceptions, but it RE-RAISES the last one; since the multibot except only names network types, a non-network bug (ValueError/KeyError/TypeError/AttributeError) propagates. Locked by test_non_network_exception_is_not_swallowed + parametrized test_non_network_bug_propagates_after_retry.

3. Success path UNCHANGED. On a working get_me the retry returns on the first try, no sleep, set_bob_identity called exactly as before. Locked by test_success_on_first_try_sets_identity_without_sleeping (get_me_calls==1, sleep.delays==[]).

4. Seam/DDD OK. ctor kwargs are backward-compatible defaults (asyncio.sleep via _LIVE_SLEEP, attempts=3, backoff=1.0s); infra-layer change only; injected sleep makes tests deterministic. `beadloom lint --strict`: 0 violations. `beadloom diff --since main`: no graph changes.

5. Retry-cost SANE. Defaults 3 attempts × 1.0s backoff = 2 sleeps = ~2s worst case before graceful degrade — bounded, will not hang startup on a hard-down network.

6. Tests genuinely lock invariants. 17 tests pass; resolve_bot_identities is 100% covered (module 66% is from other untouched methods, none of the changed lines are in the miss list). ruff + mypy --strict clean.

Minor (author discretion, non-blocking): a genuine non-network bug at startup pays the full retry budget (~2s + N "retryable operation failed" warning logs from call_with_retry) before it surfaces, because the retry primitive is exception-agnostic. Acceptable per the BOB-049 design (policy lives in the caller); noting the added latency/log-noise on the bug path only.

Verdict: OK.

comments.author: v.zoologov
comments.text:
REVIEW PASSED (OK-with-minors) — BOB-058 .1 shared-thread continuity fix.

GATES (read-only, re-run): pytest 3174 pass; ruff clean; mypy --strict clean (451 files); beadloom lint --strict 0 violations; beadloom diff --since main = no graph changes.

1. CONTINUITY (the fix) — CORRECT. Both call sites now read the SHARED thread: judge _judge_turn L2163 `_replay_recent_thread(interlocutor)`; reply L1360 same (legacy path) / reuses gate.history (live path). `_replay_recent_thread` returns `recent_episodes(k)` (whole topic, all participants). Author labels preserved end-to-end: episodes stored `"<name>: <text>\nbob: <reply>"`, `_render_thread` joins content verbatim so the judge sees distinct `<name>:` prefixes; reply history carries the same labels via `_assemble_shareable_context`. The "answer Lyosha's message" bug is genuinely fixed — other members' turns are in-context.

2. NO REGRESSION, per-author signals — CORRECT for the common case. `_absence_for(history, interlocutor)` filters via `_history_for_author` to the current author BEFORE `_last_seen_at` → another member's recent turn cannot reset THIS person's gap. `_user_turns(history, _author_label(interlocutor))` restricts anti-repeat to the current author → a different member's identical line is not a false repeat. relationship (BOB-014) / first-impression (BOB-019) untouched (own per-sender stores, keyed on sender_id).

3. GRACEFUL DEGRADATION (.2 note) — ACCEPTABLE, not a blocker. `_replay_recent_thread` is unguarded, but the PRIOR `_replay_person_history` (BOB-045) was equally unguarded — posture is UNCHANGED by this bead. On both live paths the guarded `_others_present` read (inside `_addressivity_signals`, L2064) fires first; live-reply reuses gate.history and never re-reads. The .2 worry (a replay-only failure propagating) is a pre-existing theoretical gap, not introduced here; covered in spirit by test_no_crash_when_history_read_fails_for_addressivity. Minor/acceptable.

4. PRIVACY — OK. Shared read = `recent_episodes` = ordinary public-topic traffic (BOB-051 unified public memory). No owner-private/internal channel folded in. The private/DM scope hook is inert (`del interlocutor`; always shared today) — correct per RFC scope decision.

5. FLOOR/ADDRESSIVITY (BOB-023/025) unchanged (already ran over `recent_episodes`). DDD: application-only, `recent_episodes` port untouched, no domain/infra change, no new dep, no graph change.

--- MINORS (author's discretion) ---

Minor (name-match keying) · handle_message.py `_history_for_author`/`_episode_author`/`_author_label` (L3268-3346). The per-author filter keys on the parsed `<name>` LABEL rather than `sender_id`. But `recent_episodes` rows ALREADY carry `sender_id` (sqlite_repo L330 SELECT includes it; returned in the dict). Keying the filter on `item.get("sender_id") == interlocutor.sender_id` would be strictly more robust with equal effort and is the SAME key the old per-person read used. Name-label matching is brittle in these ways (all currently degrade GRACEFULLY = signal silently dropped, never a crash/privacy issue):
  - Two members sharing the same display_name → cross-attribution: a false anti-repeat fire / suppressed absence (the one case that can actually VIOLATE the 🔴 invariant, though narrow & cosmetic).
  - Name containing ": " → `_episode_author` truncates at the first separator → mismatch → signal dropped.
  - Display-name change between turns → prior episodes under the old name no longer match → signal dropped.
  Recommendation: key per-author signals on `sender_id` (available in the mapping); elevate to Major only if homonymous members are an expected scenario.

REVIEW = BLOCKER (1 major/blocker; all other dimensions PASS). Gates green: ruff clean, mypy clean (451 files), beadloom lint 0 violations, beadloom diff no graph changes, pytest 3156 passed.

=== BLOCKER (Major) — US-3 «один поиск (не петля)» violated by the anti-repeat regeneration loop ===
File: src/bob/application/usecases/handle_message.py
- _guard_against_verbatim_repeat (BOB-032) re-invokes _compose_reply on each attractor-breaking retry (line ~2582), up to _MAX_REGENERATIONS=2.
- _compose_reply calls self._verify_note UNCONDITIONALLY (line ~2445). _verify_note re-runs judge.assess AND _verify_search_note → provider.search (line ~2760) with NO per-turn memoization.
- Result on a turn that is BOTH volatile (needs_check=True) AND trips the tic: 1 initial + up to 2 regenerations = up to 3 SEQUENTIAL web searches, each bounded by verify.timeout_seconds (default 75s) → up to ~3.75 min of serial searching. This is a LOOP of searches — CONTEXT.md 🔴 invariant US-3 says explicitly «один поиск (не петля)».
- Amplifier: verify.enabled defaults TRUE (config/loader.py) — this is LIVE in production by default, not an opt-in edge case.
- Correction to the .4 tester note: the interim line ALSO re-fires per regeneration. _send_verify_interim lives inside _verify_note, so Bob re-sends «секунду, гляну в сети…» 2-3x on a regeneration turn (visible зануда) — not once-only as flagged. The interim is once-only ONLY when no regeneration happens.

FIX (dev): compute the verify step (judge → interim → search → note) EXACTLY ONCE per turn and reuse the resulting note across regenerations.
- Compute verify_note in handle() (or on the FIRST _compose_reply) and thread it down: add param `verify_note: str | None = None` to _compose_reply — when provided, skip self._verify_note and just fold the passed note; _guard_against_verbatim_repeat passes the same note into every regeneration _compose_reply call.
- 🔴 Do NOT memoize on a HandleMessage instance attribute: it is a SHARED singleton (built once in build_application, subscribed to the bus), so an instance flag would leak across turns / concurrent turns. Keep the cache per-turn (a local variable threaded through the call chain). This makes «один поиск» pass as a consequence of real structure, and fixes the interim re-fire in the same move (interim rides the same once-per-turn compute).

=== PASS (confirmed) ===
1. authz (US-5): verify search is DIRECT provider.search (line ~2760), NOT registry.dispatch / tool-loop → does NOT hit the BOB-052 per-sender gate. Judge input is only text + this-person recent_thread; exposes only public web. BOB-051/052 on user tool-requests untouched (separate internal path). No privileged/owner-data leak.
2. no-confabulation (US-6): _verify_search_note → fail/timeout/empty all return the HONEST hedge note (_VERIFY_HEDGE_NOTE); grounded note only carries the real trimmed answer. No stale-number-as-fact.
3. не-зануда (US-2): domain parser conservative — parse_volatility_verdict returns needs_check=False on missing/negative/garbled; only affirmative+empty-query raises. System prompt «Сомневаешься — no». Genuinely biased to NOT check.

5. DDD/deps: domain pure (frozen+slots value types, Protocol port, pure prompt+parser); infra thin Tier-0 shell propagating errors; app→ports; seeded RNG injected into announcer. New TaskType VOLATILITY_JUDGE/INTERIM_LINE → Tier-0. No new runtime dependency (pyproject diff = only per-file Cyrillic RUF ignores). All new modules carry # beadloom:domain=bob (lint clean, no graph drift).

Verdict centered on the regeneration-search finding: BLOCKER — must fix (memoize verify once per turn) before merge. NOT closing.

comments.text:
РЕФЕРЕНС SSE (живой захват Responses API stream, 2026-07-01) — для точного парсинга:

Формат потока: блоки разделены пустой строкой; в каждом:
  id:N
  event:<тип>
  :HTTP_STATUS/200        ← comment-строка (начинается с ':') — игнорировать
  data:{json}             ← 🔴 БЕЗ пробела после 'data:' (не 'data: '!)

Порядок типов событий (реальный): response.created → response.in_progress → response.output_item.added → response.reasoning_summary_text.delta (×N) → response.reasoning_summary_text.done → response.output_item.done → response.output_item.added → response.content_part.added → response.output_text.delta (×N) → response.output_text.done → response.content_part.done → response.output_item.done → **response.completed** (терминал).

🔴 ПАРСИТЬ: дождаться event=response.completed → data.response.output — это ФИНАЛЬНЫЙ output[] (та же форма, что у нынешнего не-стрим ответа). Скормить существующему парсеру: items type=='web_search_call' → action.sources[].url (dedup); type=='message' → content[].output_text → answer; type=='reasoning' игнор.
(На простом запросе 'столица Франции' web_search_call не появился — модель ответила из знания; на реальном поиске он будет с action.sources, структура идентична.)

Robust: нет response.completed до конца потока → raise; delta-события НЕ нужны (берём только финальный агрегат). Строки '[DONE]'/пустые/':'-comment — пропускать.

=== 🔴 SSRF completeness & soundness — SOUND, no real bypass (highest priority) ===
- (a) Check is on RESOLVED IPs: _guard_ssrf resolves host via getaddrinfo (_default_resolve) and runs _is_blocked on EACH returned IP BEFORE any socket opens. Blocklist is fail-closed and complete: is_private OR is_loopback OR is_link_local OR is_reserved OR is_multicast OR is_unspecified — covers 127/8, 10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16, 169.254.169.254 (cloud metadata), 0.0.0.0/8, IPv6 ::1 / fc00::/7 / fe80::/10 / mapped ::ffff:*. Verified empirically: ::ffff:127.0.0.1 and ::ffff:169.254.169.254 → blocked; NAT64 64:ff9b::/96 → blocked; mapped-public ::ffff:8.8.8.8 → allowed (correct).
- (b) Redirects MANUAL (allow_redirects=False); every 3xx hop re-runs the FULL scheme+SSRF guard on the urljoin'd Location before following, capped at max_redirects. Tests lock: redirect-to-internal blocked on 2nd hop AND internal host never opened (opener.opened == ['public first hop']); scheme-downgrade to ftp:// rejected; missing Location raises.
- (d) Literal-host bypass CLOSED via getaddrinfo normalization: _parse_ip runs on getaddrinfo OUTPUT, not the raw host, so decimal (2130706433) / hex (0x7f000001) literals are resolved to 127.0.0.1 by getaddrinfo and blocked. Crucially aiohttp connects through that SAME getaddrinfo, so guard and connect agree — no divergence. IP-literal, uppercase content-type, zone-id (%eth0 stripped) all handled.

=== Minors (author discretion — none block merge) ===
- Minor [residual, DOCUMENTED-ACCEPTED — http_url_reader.py _guard_ssrf vs _AiohttpCtx]: TOCTOU / DNS-rebinding window. The guard resolves the host, then aiohttp re-resolves independently at connect (connect-by-hostname), so a rebinding attacker returning public-to-guard / private-to-aiohttp could slip through. CONTEXT §🔴 explicitly defers this ('connect-by-IP — опция на будущее') and the docstring says redirects only 'narrow' rebinding. == MAJOR: bd-show degradation — the `bd list` fallback POLLUTES the rationale (NEEDS FIX, not an acceptable-as-is limitation) ==
File: src/bob/application/capabilities/code_rationale.py `_key_section` / `_safe_tasks`; routing in subprocess_introspector.py `list_tasks`.
- parse_bead_refs yields an UPPER-case human key (e.g. `BOB-025`). In list_tasks(): _is_listing_query=False, _is_ref_id("BOB-025")=False (regex rejects uppercase) → it does NOT do `bd show`; it falls through to the UNFILTERED `bd list`. Verified live: list_tasks("BOB-025") builds `['bd','list']`.

This is misleading (a generic task list mislabeled as the decision record for a specific bead) and noisy (floods the model context — defeating the compactness the _MAX_BEAD_REFS/truncation budget exists for). It is the opposite of the US-4 honesty goal: it fabricates a code↔task relationship that doesn't exist.
- The primary "why" (PRD/RFC via feature_doc_dir) DOES resolve correctly and is genuinely useful — but the bd-list source actively pollutes the answer, so this is NOT an acceptable documented v1 limitation; the noisy source must be suppressed.
- Recommendation: in _key_section, SKIP the tracker source when the key is not a real bd hash-id (rely on feature-docs) — e.g. only call list_tasks for a key that resolves via `bd show`, or resolve BOB-key→bd-id first; never emit an unfiltered `bd list` under a per-key header. comments.author: v.zoologov
comments.text:
REVIEW PASSED (BOB-034 .2, read-only): privacy-invariant NOT weakened.

VERDICT: OK — only the two intended subtrees opened; secrets unconditionally denied; segment-boundary matching correct.

1. ALLOWLIST SCOPE (privacy_guard.py:48-65) — ALLOWED_ROOTS gains exactly '.claude/dev-docs' + '.claude/development/docs', pre-split into _ALLOWED_ROOT_SEGMENTS. allows_path now matches via _has_segment_prefix (pure segment-tuple prefix, NOT string-prefix). Verified empirically (30 cases): readable = .claude/dev-docs/**, .claude/development/docs/**, and the two root dirs themselves; DENIED = bare .claude, .claude/settings.local.json, .claude/settings.json, .claude/CLAUDE.md, .claude/agents/*, .claude/commands/*, .claude/development (bare), .claude/development/notes.md.

2. SEGMENT-BOUNDARY CORRECTNESS — the load-bearing edge cases all DENY: .claude/dev-docs-evil, .claude/dev-docs-extra, .claude/development/docs-secret, .claude/development/docstore (NOT confused with development/docs), srcfoo, tests2. _has_segment_prefix compares parts[:len(prefix)] == prefix on path segments, so no loose-prefix sibling leak.

3. SECRETS STILL DENIED — data/soul/**, data/bob.db / bob.db-wal, .env / .env.local, config/** all refused; no overlap hole with the new roots (they live under .claude/, disjoint from data//config//.env).

4. SYMLINK/REALPATH DEFENCE INTACT (BOB-031) — subprocess_introspector.read_file consults guard BEFORE disk, then _real_path_is_allowed re-asserts os.path.realpath containment against ALLOWED_ROOTS (imported, so new roots auto-covered). Containment uses Path.parents (segment-based) + equality — segment-correct. New test test_read_file_refuses_symlink_under_dev_docs_into_denied proves a link under .claude/dev-docs -> data/soul/SOUL.md is refused with no read. No new TOCTOU (name-guard then realpath-recheck, both before open()).

5. NO REGRESSION — src/tests/docs still allowed; existing BOB-017/031 tests pass.

6. CLEANLINESS — pure domain (no new deps); read_code _DESCRIPTION update accurate (roadmap/vision/feature specs visible, memory DB/soul/.env/config/settings NOT). Deterministic, prompt-unbypassable (enforced in domain+infra, not prompt). No Any / type: ignore introduced.

GATE (read-only): ruff PASS · mypy --strict PASS (296 files) · pytest 1987 passed · beadloom lint --strict 0 violations · sync-check [ok]. Empirical segment-boundary probe: 30/30 ALL PASS.

title: [BOB-035] Навык render_diagram — mermaid → PNG в Telegram
description: Боб как LLM умеет писать mermaid, но Telegram не рендерит его нативно. ЗАДАЧА (фаза 1, статика): навык render_diagram за capability-швом — принимает mermaid-источник → рендерит в PNG ЛОКАЛЬНО (mermaid-cli/mmdc, БЕЗ внешних сервисов — приватность) → отправляет в Telegram как фото (тап→зум/пан растра). Боб сам генерит mermaid, затем зовёт навык render+send. Нужно: проверить/задокументировать зависимость mmdc (@mermaid-js/mermaid-cli); порт DiagramRenderer + infra-адаптер (subprocess mmdc, таймаут, темп-файл в безопасной директории); путь отправки фото в gateway; регистрация навыка; конфиг (enabled, путь mmdc). permission=safe (только рендер своего ввода, без чтения личных данных). ВНЕ ОБЪЁМА фазы 1: интерактивный Mini App (mermaid.js webview, истинный вектор/пан/зум) — отдельная фаза. Acceptance: запрос схемы в чате → Боб присылает читаемый PNG; рендер локальный; без утечки личных данных.
